sources.quote: Omicron Ursae Majoris, formally named Muscida, is a star system in the northern circumpolar constellation of Ursa Major.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 14.9 solar radii and 3.30 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,114 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
